article.story: LOS ANGELES -- — Jevon Porter scored 19 points as Loyola Marymount beat Chicago State 86-49 on Sunday. Porter added 11 rebounds for the Lions (2-3). Zion Sensley scored 14 points and added five rebounds. Andy Sigiscar went 6 of 9 from the field to finish with 13 points. Mike Price led the way for the Cougars (2-4) with 15 points and two steals. Chicago State also got 12 points from Armari Carraway. Loyola Marymount took the lead for good with 18:40 left in the first half. The score was 47-22 at halftime, with Porter racking up 14 points. Sigiscar led the way with a team-high nine second-half points. Up next Up next for Loyola Marymount is a matchup Saturday with Cal Baptist. Chicago State visits UIC on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
